prompts.name: 01-industrial
prompts.prompt: Create ONE polished concept art sheet for a touchscreen isometric factory-building maths game. Reference screenshot establishes the existing green tile board, orthographic 2:1 isometric camera, and APPROVED conveyor look: dark charcoal belt, silver pale side rails, cyan direction arrows. Keep those conveyor design features unchanged. Redesign only wood extractor and plank factory. This is new concept art, not a screenshot edit. Composition: two large isolated three-quarter isometric machine designs across the top, each on a single compact diamond tile with an identifiable input/output port; bottom third a small in-game vignette showing these same machines connected by the existing approved conveyor. Labels 'WOOD EXTRACTOR' and 'PLANK FACTORY', minimal text, no app UI, no irrelevant buildings. Extractor visibly harvests logs from a small tree resource patch; plank factory visibly cuts brown logs into golden wooden boards. Visible working mechanisms should make future animation clear. Machinery must read at small screen sizes, compact silhouettes fitting roughly one tile, no giant buildings, no purple placeholder boxes. Stylized game asset concept rendering with consistent lighting, crisp geometry, soft ambient shadows, clean pale presentation background. Title '01 · COMPACT INDUSTRIAL'. Clean approachable low-poly machinery, warm orange painted frames with dark steel mechanisms and pale metal covers. Extractor: short articulated gripping arm feeding a log into a low output chute, small hydraulic piston. Plank factory: open metal gantry enclosing a large visible circular saw, chunky feed rollers, log input and finished plank output. Simple purposeful mechanical shapes, restrained detail, readable compact game models.
